newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - Indian GDRs flat despite Bajaj gain.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - Indian GDRs flat despite Bajaj gain.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts were almost unchanged on Wednesday despite strong gains in scooter maker Bajaj Auto after it announced a bonus issue.
Bajaj Auto closed up $1.55 at $31.38/$32.88, but failed to spark a rally in most other GDRs, traders said.
"Bajaj spilled into some other stocks but worries about petroleum hikes are still a damper," a trader said.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.02 points up at 78.68, with the premium over the local market at 21.11 percent from 21.29 percent.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index gained 38.57 points to 3,740.53.
Taiwanese GDRs proved immune to strong gains in the Taipei market.
Taipei finished up 229.50 points at 8,181.62, on strong buying of financial sector issues by government-related investment funds, traders said.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index lost 0.11 points, or 0.09 percent, to 121.46, representing a discount to the local market of 4.60 percent.
The Capel Korea GDR Index added 0.40 points to 63.24 points, a premium of 36.55 percent over the local market.
